title: ProductUsability
description: TOGAF-sourced quality archetype — Usability viability dimension. Measures the degree to which the system can be used by specified users to achieve specified goals with effectiveness, efficiency, and satisfaction. Rootless archetype — transversal to all governed entities. ISO 25010 mapping: Usability (Learnability, Operability, Accessibility, User Error Protection). Source framework: TOGAF (Architecture Principles) + ISO/IEC 25010.

learnability.description: Ease with which users can learn to use the system. Norm example: Usability.learnability == 'HIGH'.

accessibility.description: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines compliance level. Norm example: Usability.accessibility != 'NONE'.

errorProtection.description: Whether the system protects users against making errors. Norm example: Usability.errorProtection == true.
